app_name: Gestão de Performance de Vendas Byvision
personality_one_liner: A pristine, highly readable professional dashboard where crisp typography and strategic green accents drive focus to sales performance.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical padding, structured grouped content. Avoid dense edge-to-edge text. Maintain strict alignment for numerical data.

do's: Use on sticky headers over scrolling client lists
Use on bottom floating action panels for the Admin total sum
dont's: Never use on list rows or KPI cards

screens.name: Login
screens.purpose: Secure authentication for Vendedores and Admins.
screens.layout: Top half uses surfaceInverse to showcase the white Byvision logo prominently. Bottom half has simple email/password inputs with a full-width primary CTA.

screens.name: Performance Dashboard
screens.purpose: Primary command center tracking real-time sales performance against monthly goals.
screens.layout: Sticky Header with White Byvision Logo (on surfaceInverse/brandPrimary bg container to ensure visibility). Hero Section: Circular progress ring overlaying abstract green background, showing Realizado vs Provisionado vs Meta. Below: 2-col Grid of Metric Cards (Vendas Realizadas, Provisionada, Gap R$, Gap %). Followed by City Filter: horizontal scrollable chips. Below: Client List with Code, Name, City, Faturamento, and an inline horizontal bar chart showing % attainment.

screens.name: Client Detail
screens.purpose: Deep dive into a single client's history and performance.
screens.layout: Header with back button. Client Info card (CNPJ, contacts). Financial Status card (Days without purchase, Gap). Purchase History list below.

screens.name: Admin Panel
screens.purpose: Allows admins to adjust individual client sales goals (metas).
screens.layout: List of clients with inline numeric input fields to edit 'Meta'. Fixed glassmorphism bottom bar displaying the 'Soma Total das Metas' and a 'Salvar' primary button.

logo_placeholder.alt: White abstract lens logo representing Byvision

hero_bg.alt: Abstract modern light green gradient background texture

instructions_to_main_agent: IMPLEMENT THEME TOGGLE: Provide a light/dark mode switch. Ensure the `color_dark` palette is strictly followed when in dark mode.

HANDLE WHITE LOGO: The client explicitly stated the Byvision logo is a 'WHITE PNG'. In light mode, its container (like the header or login top-half) MUST be `surfaceInverse` (near black) or `brandPrimary` (#00aa79) so the white logo is visible.
NUMERICAL ALIGNMENT: Use 'Space Grotesk' for all numbers (KPIs, currency, percentages) to ensure alignment and readability. Use 'Plus Jakarta Sans' for labels, text, and names.

INLINE BAR CHARTS: In the client list, render a visual horizontal progress bar for each row showing Faturado vs Meta. Color the bar dynamically based on % attainment (e.g., success color if > 100%, warning if slightly behind, error if severely behind).
NEGATIVE GAP COLORING: Ensure Gap (R$ and %) automatically recolors to `error` if negative, and `success` if positive.
ADMIN STICKY CTA: The Admin Panel must have a sticky bottom container (glassmorphism preferred) showing the sum of all metas in real time as the admin edits the inputs.
